result.rationale: The trajectory shows a clear pattern of repeated low-information failures. From turn 1 onward, the rescue team (engineer-imani, medic-reyes, security-chen) repeatedly issues guard:command-deck intents that resolve as "no_effect" with reason "no_hostile_movement_triggered" (turns 2, 3, 4, 5), while the intended probe was "cohesive aggressive pressure against Hive Alpha." The team never actually engages Hive Alpha — the only attack in the entire run is by pirate-captain-veyra (turn 3), which is invalidated. Meanwhile, repeated "target_zone_capacity_lost" contestations occur every turn (turns 1-5) against pirate-hacker-nyx, pirate-raider-holt, and swarm drones, adding no new information. The team remains pinned at command-deck for all 6 turns, never moving toward the objective, while resources drain (battery 48→36, oxygen 68→42, reactor heat 62→100). The failures are repetitive and information-poor: the same guard actions produce no_effect, the same capacity contestations recur, and no new knowledge or contact is gained after turn 0's orbital scan. This is the dominant causal pattern blocking the aggressive-pressure probe.
